name: Uzal
overview: Uzal is a male biblical figure identified primarily as a son of Joktan. Beyond this lineage, Scripture provides no additional details about his tribe, role, or notable activities. His mention is brief, serving a genealogical purpose within the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Uzal' appears as a proper name in Scripture without any specified meaning or divine attribution. It is recorded plainly in Genesis 10:27 without further explanation of its significance.
familyAndRelationships: Uzal is recorded as a son of Joktan, establishing his place within the genealogical line presented in Genesis. No other family relationships or descendants are specified in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Uzal's importance lies in his inclusion within the genealogical account of Genesis 10, which traces the descendants of Noah's sons after the flood. As a son of Joktan, Uzal contributes to the biblical understanding of the spread of nations and peoples, underscoring God's providential plan in human history as recorded in Scripture.
